title: Bran Muffins
ldIngredientsRaw: 7 ½ ounces whole wheat flour (1 ½ cups, see note)
ldInstructionsRaw: Preheat the oven to 350 °F. Line a muffin pan with paper liners or butter and flour the pan. (see note)
In a mixing bowl whisk together 7 ½ ounces whole wheat flour, 2 ounces wheat bran, 1 teaspoon baking powder, ½ teaspoon baking soda and ½ teaspoon table salt. Toss in 5 ounces raisins.

In a separate bowl whisk together 8 ounces whole milk, 6 ounces honey, 1 ¾ ounces vegetable oil and 2 large eggs. Grate 1 large apple with the large side of a grater and add the grated apple to the milk mixture.

Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix just until combined. Scoop the batter into the muffin pan. Bake until the center of a muffin springs back when lightly pressed, about 15 minutes for standard size muffins.
